onboarding.title: Welcome to Reveric
onboarding.welcome: Let's set up your writing assistant
onboarding.language_description: Select your preferred interface language. You can change this later in settings.
onboarding.ai_provider_description: Add your own AI provider, or skip this step and configure one later on the AI Providers page.
onboarding.user_profile_description: Set your display name and avatar to personalize Reveric.
onboarding.brand_tagline: Your AI writing companion — capture ideas and create with intent.
onboarding.profile_card_subtitle: Just two steps to start your writing journey
onboarding.theme_description: Select your preferred theme and appearance mode. You can change this later in settings.
onboarding.model_defaults_description: Set default AI models for different tasks. You can change this later in settings.
onboarding.guide.providers.list_body: Popular AI providers are prelisted here. Each item shows its supported capabilities (chat, image, video, audio) and an active status dot on the right.
onboarding.guide.providers.add_body: Use this button to add OpenAI-compatible relays, third-party endpoints, or installed plugin providers.
onboarding.guide.providers.credentials_b: Official endpoints are prefilled. Enter your API key here once you have one. If you do not have one yet, feel free to continue exploring first.
onboarding.guide.providers.models_body: Chat models power writing and agents, image models power covers, characters, and canvas images, and video and audio models power storyboards and voiceovers. Fetch models automatically or add model IDs manually, and combine multiple providers as needed.
onboarding.guide.providers.enable_body: Once your API key and at least one model are set, toggle the switch in the top right to activate it. Then head to Model Settings to choose default and agent models.
onboarding.guide.providers.mobile_detail: Tap any provider to enter its API key and configure chat, image, video, and audio models. No key yet? You can continue exploring and enable it later.
onboarding.guide.providers.mobile_models: After enabling a provider, go to Model Settings to pick default chat and image models, as well as models for built-in writing agents.
onboarding.guide.home.novel_body: Your workspace for novels and stories. Let AI help outline plots, draft chapters, and organize characters and worldbuilding.
onboarding.guide.home.screenplay_body: Organize seasons, episodes, scenes, and dialogue, and collaborate with AI on episode breakdowns and storyboards.
onboarding.guide.home.canvas_body: An infinite visual canvas connecting text, image, video, and audio nodes for storyboard and short-film creation.
onboarding.guide.home.models_body: Add API keys and chat, image, video, and audio models in AI Providers, then choose default and agent models in Model Settings. Next, let's look at AI Providers.
onboarding.guide.home.skills_body: Equip AI with reusable workflows. Manage installed skills or import new ones from the Skill Directory. Next, let's look at Skills.
onboarding.guide.home.mobile_screenplay_: Organize seasons, episodes, scenes, and dialogue with AI assistance. Full visual canvas production is available on desktop.
onboarding.guide.home.mobile_assistant_b: Start AI chats, configure providers and default models under Models, and manage assistants, skills, and MCP under Agents. Next, let's look at AI Providers and Skills.
onboarding.guide.home.mobile_settings_bo: Adjust interface and reading preferences, check AI usage, and manage plugins and backups.
onboarding.guide.skills.list_body: Skills you created or imported live here. Turn one on to use it in chat, and open it to view details.
onboarding.guide.skills.market_body: Browse public skills by search or category. Click Import to add one to your Installed list.
onboarding.guide.home.gallery_body: Open the gallery from the top right of the canvas library to browse published production canvases in read-only view.
onboarding.guide.home.plugins_body: Manage installed plugins or install new ones from the marketplace. Permissions are always confirmed before installation.
onboarding.guide.home.usage_body: Track token usage and request counts as an overview or broken down by conversation.
